purpose: Four-row end-to-end smoke of the C-q8-official-raw cell before the registered 400-row Q8_0 quantization probe: prove that the Q8_0 decoder serves at the placement the placement receipt fixed, that the template-plus-fill system message and the user-turn text part after the audio survive the decoder swap, that the sealed feature cache is HIT rather than re-encoded, and that sealing and the four registered Audio2Tool scorers work on real sealed rows. It also produces the ONE number this smoke exists to produce besides legality: seconds per call, from which the 400-row wall time is projected against the registered 4.0 GPU-hour ceiling. If the projection exceeds the ceiling the flight does not take off and the owner is asked, rather than the roster being shrunk. The flight fragment a2t-q8-quantization-probe-400-v1 declares the baseline-reproduction profile and a 408-call plan, so a smoke is a separate, separately registered bounded-discovery-probe run carrying its own execution_plan. No smoke number is a task measurement.

smoke_population.selection: the SAME four rows the 2026-09-04 calibration and official-protocol replication smokes used -- the lexicographically first sample of tiers 1, 2, 5 and 6 of the frozen 400, the four tiers the acceptance rule reads

execution_plan_basis.calls: 4 rows x 1 contact = 4 for a clean first attempt. The plan registers 12 because attempt budget is enforced RUN-CUMULATIVELY: core.model.adapter.FrozenCoreAdapter re-reads every prior attempt's durable actuals for this run id on every request and refuses when prior spend plus this attempt exceeds planned_model_calls. 12 covers a clean attempt plus up to two recoveries; the exposure row's own ceiling is 20.
execution_plan_basis.speech_audio_seconds: 16.948 s for one pass, 67.792 s across four passes, rounded up to the integer contracts.ExecutionPlan requires; the exposure row's ceiling is 100.
execution_plan_basis.gpu_hours: 0.5 rather than the replication smoke's 0.2, because the Q8_0 decoder is 30.3 GiB and loads with expert tensors mapped from ext4 into host RAM; the model load alone is a materially larger share of a four-row run than it was for the resident Q4_K_M kit

evaluation.what_is_read: transport legality, the rendered prompt shape, feature-cache hits, parse rate and throughput only
evaluation.what_is_not_read: no smoke metric is a task measurement and none enters the verdict. The calibration's own smoke is the standing precedent for why: on four rows it saw zero native tool calls and concluded the model was declining the tools interface, which 400 rows corrected to 87 %.

decision.gate: the cell must complete 4 of 4 contacts, seal a verifiable manifest and score without error, and its projected 400-row wall time must sit inside the registered 4.0 GPU-hour ceiling, before the registered 408-call flight is launched
